newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM Dec palladium futures surge by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM Dec palladium futures surge by daily limit.

text.p: The December palladium futures contract on the Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) surged by its daily limit of 22 yen per gram to 517 yen in early afternoon trading on Friday.
Traders said the rise was due to an ongoing suspension of Russian exports to Japan and the yen's continued fall against the dollar.
All palladium futures contracts on TOCOM hit new highs.
"Heavy short-covering lifted palladium prices. The outlook for palladium futures remains bullish on the lingering uncertainty over the resumption of Russian exports," one trader said.
Spot palladium was quoted at $130.00/132.00 in early afternoon, against Thursday's fix of $129.00 in London.
